features.name: age_life_stage_bucket
features.description: Ordinal age band: 0 under 25, 1 age 25-34, 2 age 35-49, 3 age 50-64, 4 age 65 or older.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows trees to separate broad life-stage bands with simple threshold splits instead of repeatedly searching raw age cut points.

features.name: contact_channel_month_code
features.description: Compact interaction code for contact channel and month code, with separate month ranges for each contact channel.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct split candidate for seasonal contact-channel patterns that may otherwise require deeper tree paths.

features.name: financial_status_code2_count
features.description: Counts how many of default, housing, and loan have encoded value 2 in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses repeated high-code financial-status signals into a small ordinal count for easy tree splitting.

features.name: financial_status_code1_count
features.description: Counts how many of default, housing, and loan have encoded value 1 in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes middle-code financial-status patterns that can be sparse when handled as separate raw fields.

features.name: prior_recency_bucket
features.description: Ordinal prior-contact recency bucket: 0 sentinel or no recorded prior contact, 1 older than 30 days, 2 between 8 and 30 days, 3 within 7 days.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns the pdays sentinel and highly nonlinear recency scale into thresholds that trees can use directly.

features.name: previous_contact_volume_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for previous contact count: 0 none, 1 one, 2 two or three, 3 four or more.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable low-cardinality contact-history intensity feature for shallow tree splits.

features.name: current_campaign_pressure_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for current campaign contact count: 0 once, 1 two or three, 2 four to six, 3 seven or more.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures diminishing or nonlinear effects of repeated contact attempts with direct ordinal thresholds.

features.name: high_pressure_no_history_flag
features.description: Indicator for more than three current campaign contacts combined with zero previous contacts and the pdays sentinel.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a nonlinear interaction between current contact pressure and absent prior history for a single tree split.

features.name: prior_result_code2_recent_flag
features.description: Indicator that the previous campaign result code is 2 and pdays indicates an actual prior-contact day count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates rows with a strong prior-campaign signal and valid recency without requiring multiple split levels.

features.name: interest_rate_regime_bucket
features.description: Ordinal euribor3m regime: 0 below 1.0, 1 from 1.0 to below 2.0, 2 from 2.0 to below 4.0, 3 at least 4.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a continuous macro rate into broad regimes that tree models can split on reliably.

features.name: outreach_friction_tier
features.description: Expert-assigned ordinal tier from contact, campaign, pdays, previous, month, and day_of_week: 0 low friction, 1 mildly low, 2 neutral, 3 elevated, 4 high, 5 very high.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives trees a compact human-ranked view of contact logistics, reducing reliance on deep interaction paths.

features.name: macro_economic_stress_tier
features.description: Expert-assigned ordinal tier from emp.var.rate, cons.price.idx, cons.conf.idx, euribor3m, and nr.employed: 0 very supportive, 1 supportive, 2 neutral, 3 mildly stressed, 4 stressed, 5 very stressed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact macro regime score so trees can isolate broad economic contexts with simple splits.
